ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels in the central region and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated along the trailing edges and lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central white contiguous field. Extensive black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge of both lobes. Small, discrete dark circular mottling clusters located in the lower-medial quadrants of both lobes. A distinct yellowish-brown patch is visible in the proximal-medial section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 75 degrees and a sharp vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography. The left lobe trailing edge displays 5-6 distinct triangular peaks with moderate pixel-amplitude. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude irregular excisions and jagged peaks, particularly toward the outer third.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex sweep with a sharp upward curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, circular pixel clusters (mottling) distributed across the lower-white central areas. Small, high-contrast white clusters (likely barnacle scars) are visible on the extreme dorsal margins of the tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant non-uniform tissue loss and irregular jaggedness along the trailing edge of the right lobe, consistent with past physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellow/ochre-colored bio-staining visible on the medial surface of the left lobe.
